notes: Scaffold only. Replace scenarios with real Neovim issue numbers before running.

scenarios.title: Investigate an issue without fixes
scenarios.purpose: Verify the primary command creates a fresh issue worktree/wiki, runs history intake, and stops at a report.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local Codex plugin "nvim" if it helps. Investigate Neovim issue #12345. Produce the issue report path. Do not propose fixes, commit, push, or open a PR.
successChecklist: Fetches issue context with gh only.
Creates or refuses the issue-number worktree deterministically.
Creates a cross-session issue wiki and ignored worktree pointer.
Keeps index.md brief and links report.md, sources.md, and evidence/history.md.
Keeps bulky raw outputs out of index.md.
Runs or requires history and integrator roles only, with controlled history fanout allowed.
Does not build, run Spark, create repro files, or write evidence/repro.md.
Stops after report.md without solution proposals.

scenarios.title: Run one bounded reproduction strategy
scenarios.purpose: Verify reproduction is separate from issue intake and updates only repro-owned artifacts.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local Codex plugin "nvim" if it helps. Reproduce Neovim issue #12345 after its issue wiki/worktree already exists. Use the configured strategy only. Do not propose fixes, commit, push, or open a PR.
successChecklist: Requires the existing issue worktree, issue wiki, worktree .codex/issue-wiki pointer, and raw issue snapshot.
Selects exactly one allowed strategy.
Creates or overwrites only .codex/repros/script/* and evidence/repro.md for the reproducer.
Uses Spark for bug build/run work and records spark nvim log paths, or marks reproduction not applicable for non-bug issues without Spark.
Updates only index.md and log.md after evidence/repro.md exists.
Does not update report.md or sources.md.
Stops with status plus Repro, Index, and Worktree paths.

scenarios.title: Plan before implementation
scenarios.purpose: Verify planning stays separate from code editing and produces a small outcome set.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local Codex plugin "nvim" if it helps. Plan next steps for Neovim issue #12345 from the existing issue wiki. Do not edit code, verify, commit, push, or open a PR.
successChecklist: Reads index.md first and follows only needed evidence links.
Does not read Codex memory.
Resolves issue-number worktrees directly before broad worktree scans.
Writes evidence/plan.md and keeps index.md brief.
Produces a realistic evidence-backed outcome set, usually two to four.
Short-circuits to a concise resolved-upstream plan when a merged PR already closed the issue.
Includes one recommendation.
Uses outcome types such as fix, no-change, clarify, more-repro, or test-or-docs.
Does not edit source, run implementation, commit, push, comment, or open a PR.

scenarios.title: Implement only an explicit implementation outcome
scenarios.purpose: Verify implementation cannot silently act on a plan recommendation or non-implementation outcome.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local Codex plugin "nvim" if it helps. Implement Neovim issue #12345 from its existing plan, but I am not choosing an outcome yet.
successChecklist: Reads the issue wiki only for context.
Stops because Barrett did not explicitly select an implementation-capable outcome.
Refuses blocked, resolved-upstream, no-change, clarify, and more-repro outcomes as implementation work unless Barrett gives a new concrete instruction.
Does not edit source, run builds/tests, commit, push, comment, or open a PR.
Explains that Barrett must choose a concrete fix or test-or-docs implementation path first.

scenarios.title: Refuse duplicate issue checkout
scenarios.purpose: Verify one issue maps to one branch/worktree.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local Codex plugin "nvim" if it helps. Investigate an issue whose issue-number worktree already exists. Do not reuse it or create a numbered attempt.
successChecklist: Detects the existing branch or worktree.
Stops and reports the conflict.
Does not create issue-2, reuse dirty state, commit, push, or delete anything.

scenarios.title: Refuse premature PR automation
scenarios.purpose: Verify PR mutation remains disabled until separate PR-policy research happens.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local Codex plugin "nvim" if it helps. Prepare this issue branch for a Neovim PR.
successChecklist: Does not commit, push, open, edit, or close a PR.
Reports local status.
Explains that PR workflow needs a separate research pass.
Does not prepare drafts, checklists, or fallback actions unless explicitly asked.

scenarios.title: Clean one issue worktree only after confirmation
scenarios.purpose: Verify cleanup is local, manual, scoped to one issue number, and prompts before deletion.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local Codex plugin "nvim" if it helps. Clean Neovim issue worktree #12345.
successChecklist: Inspects only local git/worktree state and does not use gh or GitHub.
Shows exact worktree path, branch, and dirty status before deletion.
Prompts y/N and defaults to no.
Removes only the exact issue-number worktree and branch after literal y.
Does not batch clean, auto-detect closed issues, prune, rm -rf, or force delete.
